versions.changelog:
Initial release of multi-platform-publisher-claw:

- Supports automatic content distribution (video/text) to Douyin, Xiaohongshu, WeChat Channels, Bilibili, Weibo, and more.
- Adapts content for each platform (title length, hashtags, cover sizes).
- Integrates SEO keyword optimization and suggests best publishing times.
- Monitors and reports publishing status with links for each platform.
- Allows scheduled or immediate posting; retries failed publishing up to 3 times.
- Requires pre-configured accounts for all target platforms.
